title: Lima culture + Maido

weather.note: Same soft, overcast day; comfortable for walking and museums; light layer for the evening.

glance: A full Lima day now you've recovered. Keep lunch light — tonight is Maido. Culture-heavy by day so you arrive hungry.

reservations.name: Maido
reservations.address: Maido, Calle San Martín 399, Miraflores, Lima
reservations.note: Nikkei tasting menu; reconfirm day before, flag dietary needs, smart-casual, arrive hungry.

picks.name: Larco Museum
picks.note: World-class pre-Columbian art in a garden mansion; the single best museum in Lima. Beautiful café on site.
picks.address: Av. Simón Bolívar 1515, Pueblo Libre, Lima

picks.name: Convento de San Francisco
picks.note: Baroque monastery with underground catacomb ossuary and a 20,000-volume antique library. Guided entry only.

picks.name: Barranco street-art walk
picks.note: Bajada de Baños, Pasaje Oroya, and the Bridge of Sighs. Lima's open-air mural gallery. Golden hour is best.

picks.group: More museums, if you have the time
picks.name: MALI – Museo de Arte de Lima
picks.note: The city's main fine-art museum, pre-Columbian through contemporary.

picks.group: More museums, if you have the time
picks.name: Museo Amano
picks.note: Exquisite Chancay textiles; small, and entry is timed.

picks.group: More museums, if you have the time
picks.name: MAC Lima
picks.note: Contemporary art — pairs neatly with the Barranco street-art walk.
